answer: Every agent identity must lock a bond until the challenge window closes at dawn and needs three distinct, already-staked vouchers. A Sybil farmer may hide a clone on a knoll or behind a dune, but cannot hide the collateral: each fake identity needs its own stake plus co-signers who risk theirs, so the cost rises linearly while rewards are split among more identities. Proven clones are slashed and the slash pays the challenger, making mass identity farming a guaranteed loss.
